prediction.sql: WITH CharterSchoolInfo AS (SELECT frpm.CDSCode, schools.Zip AS Zip, schools.City AS City, frpm."School Name" AS CharterSchoolName, frpm."Charter Funding Type" AS "Charter Funding Type", frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS Enrollment, frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS PercentFRPM, CASE WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.75 THEN 'High FRPM' WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.50 THEN 'Medium FRPM' ELSE 'Low FRPM' END AS FRPMCategory, STRFTIME('%Y', schools.OpenDate) AS YearOpened, CASE WHEN schools.ClosedDate IS NULL OR schools.ClosedDate = '' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Closed' END AS CurrentStatus FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE frpm."District Name" = 'Fresno County Office of Education' AND frpm."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 AND frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0), SATPerformance AS (SELECT c.CDSCode, c.Zip, c.City, c.CharterSchoolName, c."Charter Funding Type", c.Enrollment, c.PercentFRPM, c.FRPMCategory, c.YearOpened, c.CurrentStatus, s.NumTstTakr AS SATTestTakers, (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) AS TotalSATScore, CASE WHEN s.NumTstTakr IS NULL OR s.NumTstTakr = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr END AS PercentageAbove1500 FROM CharterSchoolInfo AS c LEFT JOIN satscores AS s ON s.cds = c.CDSCode AND s.rtype = 'S') SELECT Zip, City, CharterSchoolName, "Charter Funding Type", Enrollment, PercentFRPM, FRPMCategory, YearOpened, CurrentStatus, SATTestTakers, TotalSATScore, PercentageAbove1500, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSATScore DESC) AS SATRanking, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Enrollment DESC) AS EnrollmentRanking FROM SATPerformance ORDER BY CASE WHEN TotalSATScore IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, TotalSATScore DESC, Enrollment DESC
joins: LEFT JOIN satscores ON s.cds = c.CDSCode AND s.rtype = 'S'
order_by: CASE WHEN TotalSATScore IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC
